column2: HOST-USB: every protocol command byte recovered from the FT3DR/DE ver 1.02 host tooling.
Three distinct protocols live in these binaries.  Sections are separated by "##" rows.
Columns: proto | cmd_hex | on_the_wire | direction | meaning | evidence | reachable
proto = H8S      Hitachi/Renesas H8S boot-mode command set. Selected when the
update descriptor word at image_end+0x3C ... +0x40 == 6.
FT3D_MAIN_ver102(EXP).exe carries 6 -> this is the MAIN path.
proto = RX       Renesas RX (RX64M) boot-mode command set, SOD/LNH/LNL/CMD/SUM/ETX framing.
Descriptor word == 7. FT3D_SUB_ver102(ALL).exe carries 7 -> the SUB path.
proto = GEN      A third "generic writer download" state machine (descriptor word == 5).
Present in BOTH EXEs, selected by NEITHER.  Unreachable as shipped.
proto = E8A      RComms.dll's own E8a/E10A-USB on-chip-debug protocol (64-byte frames,
A5F05A0F magic).  Reached only through the ULE_* / HUDI_* / E7_* exports,
which neither updater EXE calls.  Unreachable from the shipped UI.
Addresses with no module prefix are in the named EXE at image base 0x400000.
RComms.dll is at image base 0x10000000.
cmd_hex
== H8S / 2370 boot mode: framing = CMD [SIZE] [data...] [SUM], SUM = -(sum of all preceding bytes) & 0xFF

column2: == RX / RX64M boot mode: framing = SOD LNH LNL CMD [data...] SUM ETX ==
SOD = 0x01 for a command packet, 0x81 for a data packet.  LNH/LNL = big-endian byte count of CMD+data.
SUM = -(LNH+LNL+CMD+data) & 0xFF.  ETX = 0x03 (last) or 0x17 ETB (more data follows).
Error reply = CMD|0x80 with a 1-byte error code in data[0].

selection with one parameter (0). Error reply 0xD0.
SPECIFY ADDRESS RANGE. start = descriptor+0x08 = 0xFFC00000, end = descriptor+0x10 = 0xFFFFFFFF. After the reply the host sets the write block size to 1024.

column2: == E8A: RComms.dll on-chip-debug protocol.  64-byte frames on the bulk pipes. ==
Frame:  [0..1] seq u16 LE (1..200, rolling) | [2..3] len u16 LE = 64 |
[4..7] A5 F0 5A 0F | [8..11] payload length BE | [12..15] command BE |
[16..] parameters BE | F0 A5 0F 5A | zero pad to 64 bytes
